draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.24, the 72nd-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 4th of 18 at RB. He lasted until pick 143, well after his grade rank (72nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Isiah Pacheco. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,431 rushing yards in 2022, 6th of 18 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Dallas Cowboys (practice squad). 6 career games and 0 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 1 AV in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile), team carry share 14.2% (25th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2023. Versus the typical Year-1 running back who played: 113 scrimmage yards against a median of 267, below the norm.
